channel.title: Mr.GOLEM — Writing
channel.description: Reverse engineering, malware analysis and defensive tooling.

item.title: How Discord token grabbers work — and how to stop them
item.description: A token is a bearer credential: whoever holds it is you. This is how grabbers find it, why file-only antivirus misses them, and the checks that actually help.

item.title: ADB and fastboot on Windows: a practical diagnostic guide
item.description: Set up platform-tools, authorise the device, read the right properties and tell ADB, fastboot, download mode, EDL and preloader apart — without flashing anything.

item.title: DNS ad blocking on Android without root: how VpnService filters work
item.description: Why a local VPN can block ads system-wide without root, what it sees, and the four cases where DNS filtering still loses.

item.title: Building a TOTP vault in .NET: AES-GCM, PBKDF2 and the limits
item.description: The math behind six-digit codes, how to store the shared secrets, and why a hard-coded PIN check quietly ruins the whole design.
